provenance.note: This resumed semantic audit inspected all target values. Earlier blocked attempt reported openai/gpt-6.1-sol fallback and inspected no targets; that attempt is not approval evidence.

semantic_checks.action: Non-delivery discard verb agrees with existing localized single-message action; ellipsis retains confirmation step.
semantic_checks.confirm: Restricts operation to listed snapshot, excludes new arrivals, retains irreversible device-local recording, unavailable text and no notification guarantee.
semantic_checks.submit: Executes listed messages with count label, not an unbounded future set; grammatical with count 1.
semantic_checks.progress: Counts processed attempts without promising successful recording, delivery or notification; numeric label avoids agreement errors.
semantic_checks.result: Distinguishes locally recorded decisions from unconfirmed attempts; records remain in displayed list, without asserting no write or remote held state.
semantic_checks.retry: Retries failed messages, retains confirmation ellipsis and does not invite new arrivals.
semantic_checks.recorded: States device-local discard record only, not delivery or server confirmation.
semantic_checks.stale_receipt: Record changed, not necessarily message text; refresh and re-confirm, without asking to reread unseen text.
semantic_checks.local_unconfirmed: Terminal local discard; no server confirmation, sender notification uncertain, no further local action.

coverage.locale_notes: مسترد کریں matches existing discard action. Respectful imperatives and Urdu punctuation are consistent; total-before-done order is natural Urdu and preserves placeholder roles.

copy_scan.method: Loaded approved script through skill read; invoked scan() in persistent Python kernel on English plus seven target files.

structural_check.method: Exact keyset; regex placeholder multiset equality per key; unicodedata NFC equality; no ALM/LRM/RLM/embedding/override/isolate bidi controls.

limitations: Source-copy/semantic audit only; no rendered fit, font, clipping, pseudo-localization or runtime RTL claim.
One independent audit instance per locale; does not substitute for any required additional high-visibility audit.
